content:
The v4.18.0-rc1 release of Lean is here!

There are many bugfixes, performance gains, and improvements to the Lean language. Please read the release notes for details.

Batteries, Aesop, ProofWidgets, and Mathlib are all now available for v4.18.0-rc1.

  • there is a v4.18.0-rc1 tag in each repository if you would like to pin to a commit using this toolchain.
